scope_statement: Recompute direct PF eigenvalue-error cost curves on H2/H4/H5/H6/H7 and test whether the domain-restricted direct optimum is predictably related to H-chain size. Prior H-chain results were inspected before this protocol, so this is not an independent holdout.

target.infeasible_rule: cost is null when abs(delta_E_direct) >= epsilon_E

excluded.reason: The stored short-time m5/Y8 errors are below the fixed 5e-12 Ha fitting floor, so the common normalized search coordinate cannot be defined reliably. It must not be silently mixed into the scaling fit.
Exact dense direct diagonalization over the fixed multi-time grid is outside the practical capacity of the local 4 GiB GPU/CPU environment. H8 is reserved as a future independent holdout.

time_grid.role_of_analytic_time: normalization and finite-domain definition only; it is not used to choose the direct optimum within the grid
time_grid.selection: minimum finite continuously-tracked direct cost on the complete fixed grid
time_grid.boundary_rule: a minimum at the first or final grid point is not scorable
time_grid.claim_scope: domain-restricted discrete optimum; not a global optimum over all positive time

branch_tracking.initialization: maximum exact-ground-state overlap at the first time
branch_tracking.continuation: maximum overlap with the previously selected Schur vector
branch_tracking.crosscheck: maximum-ground-overlap and continuously-tracked energy shifts must agree at every sampled time

optimum_robustness.zero_crossing_rule: report whether the connected 1-percent near-optimal component intersects a signed direct-error sign-change interval
optimum_robustness.coarse_grid_uncertainty: report the immediate sampled neighbor bracket around the selected point

scaling_analysis.validation: leave-one-size-out on H2/H4/H6; H5/H7 are descriptive only

interpretation_limits: The cost is the repository's continuous QPE precision-allocation proxy, not a complete end-to-end QPE implementation cost.
The grid coverage was informed by previously inspected H-chain results, so the result is retrospective.
A stable H2/H4/H6 relation is small-system evidence only; H8 remains necessary for an independent even-chain holdout.
Failure to find a predictable law is a valid scientific result and must not trigger threshold or domain changes in this run.
